# Contributing

Thank you for taking an interest in Arboresce.

## Changes

Keep each change coherent and reviewable. Explain the behavior it changes and how it was checked.
Use a short, imperative commit subject that describes the change.

Use material you have the right to contribute. Retain attribution for reused work.
Contributions are licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

## Documentation and generated files

Use calm, direct language and repository-local relative links.
Follow [documentation ownership](docs/ownership.md) and [generated artifact guidance](docs/generated-artifacts.md).
Do not include credentials or personal information.

## Review

Run the applicable documented checks and report the results.
Follow the local [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
For security reports, read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
